frames.label: Career political operator
strongestEvidence: Long legislative tenure and committee concentration
weakPoints: Tenure can be reframed by him as readiness
frames.likelyRebuttal: Experience is exactly why I can run the office effectively.
frames.defensiveCounter: Experience is valuable when paired with measurable service outcomes and voter trust.

frames.label: Insider control politics
strongestEvidence: Pattern framing around centralized election-process control
weakPoints: Requires disciplined sourcing to avoid overreach
frames.likelyRebuttal: I follow the law and protect election integrity.
frames.defensiveCounter: Integrity and broad participation are strongest together, with transparent implementation.

frames.label: Power over participation
strongestEvidence: Cross-bill process-tension themes in KH-2 and KH-3 pattern lanes
weakPoints: Needs county-level examples for broad persuasion
frames.likelyRebuttal: Rules keep elections secure and fair.
frames.defensiveCounter: Rules should protect security without sidelining lawful participation.
